subject: Revenue runway check + stage cleanup — prep & call agenda
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Revenue runway check + stage cleanup — prep & call agenda

Team —

Quick reminder: our weekly runway & commit call is at 10:00 AM PT today. I want us to go into the meeting with the following done so we can keep the call to 30 minutes and lock the entries we plan to count toward the month. Please action the checklist below before the call (I will run a short pre-call triage at 9:50).

Pre-call checklist (high priority)
- Update stage to one of: Prospect, Opportunity, Commit, At-Risk, Closed Lost for all deals > $50k in the pipeline.
- Ensure expected close date and best-case close date are populated for Commit-stage deals.
- Attach the updated ARR math or note link to the deal (see Drive template).
- Mark any deals where legal/procurement or SOC2 security review is outstanding (tag as "proc_security_pending").

Agenda (30 min total)
1) 10:00–10:05 — Quick runway snapshot (me) — show top 10 deals by ARR and any concentration risk.
2) 10:05–10:15 — Commit triage (Marissa) — confirm which deals are commit-ready and which need follow-ups.
3) 10:15–10:25 — Stage cleanup & flags (Sean) — highlight deals to move to At-Risk or Close Lost.
4) 10:25–10:30 — Action items & owners (Lauren) — agree on owner follow-ups and timing.

Attachments:
- Quarterly_Pipeline_Template.xlsx (xlsx) — please use this to confirm ARR math.
- runway_calculator.csv (csv) — quick model used for today's snapshot.

Drive prep: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-runway-brief
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=runway-call-20261208

Key asks: prioritize Commit-stage verification and flag any deals where customer procurement >= 2 weeks out. If you will not be on the call, update your deal rows and add a short note in the comments column so the pair on the call can speak for you.

Thanks — see you at 10.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
